title: A 52 Week Study To Assess The Use Of Bococizumab (PF-04950615; RN316) In Subjects With Heterozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia

sections.abstract:
This is a multicenter, randomized study in subjects with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia receiving highly effective statins to assess the safety, efficacy and tolerability of Bococizumab (PF-04950615; RN316) to lower LDL-C.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in Low Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at Week 12. timeframe=Baseline, Week 12. Placebo=-0.3 (±18.30); PF--04950615=-54.2 (±29.34). p=<0.001
